integration_evidence.name: Framer Server API
integration_evidence.finding: Framer supports project-scoped programmatic access through framer-api. A project connection is required; a GitHub repository does not become a Framer site automatically.

integration_evidence.name: Framer external agents
integration_evidence.finding: External agents can edit canvas components and CMS after an explicit project connection. Setup and access grants have not been performed.

integration_evidence.name: Figma to Framer
integration_evidence.finding: The official Figma plugin copies design layers into Framer. Responsive behavior and interactions require refinement. This is not evidence of bidirectional live sync.

integration_evidence.name: Framer hosting and export
integration_evidence.finding: Framer does not provide standalone HTML export for self-hosting. Keep the repository as the independent content and implementation source if code portability is required.
